channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Cloudflare’s Auto Router Rates Each Request for Stakes, from the Most Recent Turns
item.description: Cloudflare has released Auto Router in public beta through AI Gateway, picking a model per request from a classifier that scores complexity, ambiguity, stakes and context dependence. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: MCP C# SDK 2.0 Makes HTTP Stateless by Default and Adds Multi Round-Trip Requests
item.description: Microsoft announced version 2.0 of the official MCP C# SDK, which implements the 2026-07-28 revision of the Model Context Protocol with stateless HTTP servers by default, standardised routing headers and Multi Round-Trip Requests. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Wails v3.0.0 Released
item.description: Wails v3.0.0 is here: multiple windows, system tray, native menus, services and generated bindings, an updater, mobile support and a new documentation site. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: PHP Patches Two Critical RCE Flaws That Were Already Under Attack
item.description: PHP released 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35 to fix two critical vulnerabilities allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: PyTorch Conference 2026: Google and Meta Open-Source TorchTPU for Native PyTorch on TPUs
item.description: Google and Meta open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Google's TPUs, at PyTorch Conference North America 2026, and Meta said it plans to move larger LLM workloads onto TPUs with it. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Google ML Drift Accelerates On-Device AI Inference Across Diverse GPUs
item.description: Google has released ML Drift, an open-source, cross-platform GPU compute engine designed for on-device AI and machine learning inference. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Quick Now Available in the AWS Singapore Region
item.description: Amazon Quick is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Singapore) region (ap-southeast-1). This launch allows customers in Singapore to access the full power of Amazon Quick while meeting local requirements for data sovereignty. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Service Reference Information now supports global condition keys, service names, and data plane classification
item.description: AWS is expanding programmatic service reference information to help you automate IAM policy management and keep your policies aligned with the latest service updates. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon S3 server access log delivery to Amazon CloudWatch Logs now available in five additional AWS Regions
item.description: Amazon S3 server access log delivery to Amazon CloudWatch Logs is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, and AWS China Regions. (1 source: aws)
